(cha)༄༅/ /sher phyin yi ge gcig ma'i gzhung gsal byed dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo e ka akṣa rā ya/gzhung shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni

tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// sher phyin yi ge gcig ma'i gzhung gsal byed dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo e ka akṣa rā ya/ gzhung shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bye ba phrag brgyad pa la sogs pa'o// lam sher phyin ni lam lnga la sbyar ba'o// don sher phyin ni stong pa nyid do// de la don brjod pa'i gzhung yi ge gcig ma'i man ngag ni/ nangs par gnyid sad pa dang mal nas langs te khrus byas la stan la rdo rje skyil krung gis 'dug ste/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad de'i go 'phang la dgod par bya snyam du sems bskyed la 'di skad nas 'di lta'i bar du bzla/ de las snod bcud sa lam la sogs pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa stong pa nyid du bsams pas 'byung ba ma yin te/ rang bzhin gyi gnas pa ma yin no// de la blo bzhag la/ a zhes pa nyi shu rtsa gcig gong bas thos tsam du bzla'o// bla ma dha byang sems ni aṃ zhes bya ba yin te/ thig le shes rab a thabs so// zhes gsungs so// 'di ni a zlo ba don thabs shes rab bo// de lta bu don nyi shu rtsa gcig gdon yang 'gal ba med do// de nas rjes su yi rang ba bton la dge ba bsngo// smon lam btab ste ldang ngo*// de lta bu ni bka' rgyas pa tshar re bton pa dang mnyam mo// de ni don thams cad 'dir 'dus pa'i phyir ro// de ltar yang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las// a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /ces gsungs so// byang sems bai ro'i 'o// / zhes dpal sa skya pa'i man ngag gces btus las byung ba'o// ༈ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sher phyin yi ge gcig ma'i gzhung gi don gyi man ngag ni lnga ste/ rang bzhin sgra la sems gzung thabs gnad dang bcas pa dang*/ rten phyag rgya la brten nas sems gzung ba dang*/ lus gnad rlung gi bye brag la brten te sems gzung ba dang*/

gdon thabs phan yon dang bcas pa dang*/ srung ba bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ gzhag thabs dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ skyon 'chos thabs so// dang po ni/ bya ba thams cad btang la/ gnas dben par 'dug lus cha mnyam la/ a zhes ring po brjod la sgra la shes pa gtad/ skad je phra je phra la nyal gyis gtong*/ sems nam zin zin gyi bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ ngo bo shes pa gsal la mi rtog pa sing nge ba'o// gsal la ma byings ma rmugs pa'o// mi rtog pa las ma 'phros pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis te/ mnyam gzhag dang*/ rjes thob bo// mnyam gzhag la gnyis te/ rgod pa dang bying ba'o// dang po ni a thung ngu bgrang zhing*/ a'i sgra la shes pa gtad la shes pa dmad pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ shes pa gzengs bstod la sgo lnga bsal bar byas te/ a ring po nar gyis bgrang*/ yang nas yang du bsgom par bya'o// rjes thob ni/ a skye med dang rtogs pa dus mtshungs so// de la goms par bya ba'i thabs ni/ brjod bya don gyis bskul bar bya'o// de yang bdag la brngan bgrangs zhing smod pa dang*/ chags sdang nam skyes tsam na yang*/ a zhes brjod pas skye med kyi don dran par bya'o// gnyis pa rten phyag rgya la sems gzung ba ni gnyis te/ gzhag thabs ni mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya bcings la srin lag gnyis la shes pa gtad/ a zhes ring por bklag a ru gsal bar bsam zhing bsgom na mi zin mi srid do// sems can gyi sems spros bral du bzhugs pa'i brdar yi ge ar gnas/ de ltar ma shes te rnam rtog gis bsgribs pa'i brdar khrag sbal ni me'i tshul du gnas/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas ye shes rlung srog dag pa'i yi ge a wa dhū tī nas yar tshangs pa'i bu gar 'jug pas 'pho bar yang 'gyur/ las kyi rlung sna bug nas rgyu bas a yi phyi nang rtog med du 'char/ skyon bcos pa ni/ gong gi de la rgod pa mi 'ong*/ bying na phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag la mig yar bzlog cing*/

a zhes brjod cing a la shes pa sing sing gtad do// gsum pa lus gnad ni gsum ste/ sngon byung ston pas brtag tshul ni/ ston pa 'khor tshogs na chos gsung ba de tsam na/ phyag gnyis pus mo la bzhag nas/ zhal 'dzum mdzad nas a zhes brjod pas sa g.yo ba byung bas da lta yang sems mi zin mi srid do// gzhag thabs ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang tshul mthun par byas te/ mchu btsums nas a ring khong nas bgrang*/ skad sna nas drag tu bgrang ngo*// dbugs tshangs pa'i bu gar 'gro bas sems zin no// de 'dra ba yang dang yang du byas nas rlung tshangs pa'i bu gar 'gro bas lus gnad kyis mi zin mi srid do// skyon bcos pa ni/ rgod pa ni smin mtshams su a gsal bar bsgoms pas shes pa mi 'phro/ bying ba la a'i sgra mig nas bton te a zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas mig ldem ldem byas shing*/ a'i sgra mig nas phar sangs sangs 'ong bar bsam mo// des gnyid yul dbyung ba'o// bzhi pa gdon thabs phan yon dang bcas pa la gnyis te/ bdag don dang gzhan don no// dang po la bzhi ste/ sems bskyed pa/ khrus bya ba/ yum bskyed pa/ yum gdon pa'o// de la dang po sems bskyed pa ni/ rang don las log nas sems can gyi don bya bar sems bskyed/ de ltar rtogs pa rgyud la ldan par sems bskyed pa'o// gnyis pa khrus la gsum ste/ skam khrus dang*/ gsher khrus dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khrus so// dang po ni nangs par langs la/ khams bsing*/ snabs lud dbyi/ mig rnag dbyi/ kha sgo bsal la mdo gdon pa'o/ gsher khrus ni/ nangs par langs la/ dang po chu 'khyor bar blugs la kha bshal/ gnyis pa kha ru blugs la mid/ de nas lag pa bkru/ des ni lus kyi sdig pa dag pa'o// byad bkrus pas ngag gi sdig pa dag pa'o// sngar gyi sdig pa dag nas phyis mi byed par dam bcas pas yid kyi sdig pa 'dag go /ting nge 'dzin gyi khrus ni/

snying gar a gcig bsam/ a de las a grangs med pa spros la/ rang gi bag chags kyi rten phung po bsregs nas mi dmigs par bsam mo// gsum pa yum bskyed pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdzogs tshul du bskyed pa ni/ sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog 'dra ba/ gdan ni ma chags padma/ bzhugs tshul ni 'gro don mdzad pa'i phyir bzhengs sku/ phyag g.yas dang po ni sems can gyi nyon mongs drwa ba gcod pa'i rtags su ral gri/ 'og ma na sems can thams cad 'khor ba nas 'dren pa'i rtags su bgrang phreng mtheb srin gyis bzung ba/ phyag g.yon gyi dang po mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ 'og ma na pusti bsnams pa'o// bzhi pa yum gdon pa ni/ rang yum du gsal bas rgya gar skad nas 'di lta ste yan chad gdon/ de nas yum med par a lce thog tu gsal/ de yang skye med du yal bar bsams nas a zhes ring bar nyi shu rtsa gcig bton pas/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i ngang du lhangs kyis gsal ba'o// de'i don ni smra bsam brjod med ces pa'i don no// de nas bcom ldan 'das zhes pa nas rdzogs so zhes pa yan chad gdon no// 'di ltar bton na sdig pa byed cing bton pa'i 'bum tshar re bas dga' gsungs so// gnyis pa gzhan don ni/ gong du 'di lta ste yan chad mthun/ nam mkha' la bltas te a bcu gcig brjod pas/ steng gi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can rnams kyis dang po skye med tshig tu thos/ gnyis pas go/ gsum pas don dang ldan/ bzhi pas don mi 'gyur bas skye ba med par bsam mo// des 'gre'o// de ltar phyogs bcur bton pas a brgya dang bcu them pa'o// de ni khe drag 'dod pas srog bcad cing gzhan la bsdus bsdus pa'i chos gcig pas dga' 'o// bdag don gzhan don gnyis ka la dang po sems bskyed 'byung*/ bar du mi dmigs pa gcig 'ong*/ tha mar bsngo ba yong ba'o// de ltar byas na tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgya ba'o// gang nas bshad na/

nyi khri'i rtag tu ngu nas bshad cing*/ rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa nas kyang bshad do// bzhi pa srung ba ni/ sems can rnams la phan pa dang zhes pas/ bdag gzhan don gnyis ka'i lus srung ba la gsum ste/ dang po phyi stong pa nyid ni stong pa'i go cha bla na med pa'o// de yang phyi 'jig pa'i yul 'byung ba lnga dang dgra bgegs thams cad stong pa las mi gzhan pas bsgrub rgyu med/ a zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas rang sar 'jig bar du gcod pa'i yul med pa'o// gnyis pa nang stong pa nyid ni 'jig pa'i phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched thams cad a nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas stong par bsgom/ 'dzin pa'i sems stong pa nyid de a zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod la stong pa nyid du bsgom mo// gsum pa stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni stong pa rang du yang 'dod rgyu med pa la bya ste/ a zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas/ stong pa rang du 'dod pa dang bral bar bsam mo// de ni chen po stong pa nyid ces stong pa phyogs gcig tu ma song bas so// nyi tshe ba'i stong pa mi srid pa'i chos bzhi

ri bong rwa/ nam mkha'i me tog ru sbal spu/ mo gsham gyi bu'o// lta bu ma yin pa/ bkag nas stong pa'am/ bshig nas stong pa'am/ med nas stong pa lta bu ma yin te/ snang ba thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa'o// rang rig pa de nyid lta bur 'byung ba'o// bla ma sa skya pa chen po nas brgyud pa'i gdams ngag rdzogs so// ༈ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// yi ge a gdon pa'i gdams ngag ces kyang bya/ grib sel ba'i man ngag ces kyang bya/ 'di nyams su len par 'dod pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis/ dang por sems bskyed bya ba ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bar chad zhi ba dang*/ sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i don du a gdon par bya snyam du sems bskyed la/ dngos gzhi lha bsgom pa dang*/ sngags bzla ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas rang nyid yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yon gyi dang po mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ g.yas gnyis kyi dang po la lar rdo rje/ skyabs sbyin mdzad pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pusti bsnams pa/ g.yas gnyis pa rdo rje la lar phreng ba bshad/ bsnams pa/ nu ma sra ba 'bur ba/ sked pa phra ba/ rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa zhig bsam la/ de nyid kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po zhig bsam/ mgrin par āḥdamar po zhig bsam/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag cig bsam/ gnyis pa la las tshogs bdun las/ dang po ni/ ngag tu oṃ brjod pas spyi bo'i oṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad la phog de rnams oṃ du gyur par bsam/ oṃ yang brtsigs pa bzhin du cher 'bur nyer 'bur bzhugs par bsams la/ ngag tu oṃ mang du bgrang bar bya'o// de ltar byas nas pha bsad ma thag dang mtshams med pa lnga byas pa'i mi la chos bshad kyang grib mi 'ong ngo*// mi brdzun che ba'am ngag gi sgo nas sdig pa shas cher spyad pa'i skyes bu 'ga' zhig la chos bshad dgos na/

gnyis pa ni/ yum chen mo'i nga rgyal dang ldan par byas la ngag tu a brjod pas mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od 'phros/ phyi snod nang bcud thams cad la phog pas de rnams ar gyur par bsam/ cher 'bur nyer 'bur yod par bsams la/ ngag tu a mang du brjod la chos bshad par bya/ de ltar byas na grib mi 'ong ngo*// gsum pa ni/ yum chen mo'i nga rgyal dang ldan par byas la ngag tu hūm̐ brjod pas/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyi snod nang bcud thams cad hūm̐ gi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ hūm̐ de rnams kyang brtsigs pa bzhin du cher 'bur nyer 'bur yod par bsams la ngag tu hūm̐ mang du brjod na grib kyis mi tshugs so// bzhi pa ni/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ nam mkha' gang bar cher 'bur nyer 'bur gtams pa spros pa rnams/ phyag na rdo rjer gyur te ngag tu brjod pas/ chom po la sogs pa'i 'jigs skrag zhi bar 'gyur/ lnga pa ni/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas a cher 'bur nyer 'bur gtams pa spros pa rnams/ 'jam dpal du gyur te a zhes ngag tu brjod pas khro ba dang gdug sems dang ldan pa rnams kyi bsam pa zhi bar 'gyur ro// drug pa ni/ spyi bo'i oṃ las oṃ cher 'bur nyer 'bur gtams pa spros pa rnams/ thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tu gyur te oṃ zhes ngag tu brjod pas/ mi gtsang ba dang*/ nyam nga ba dang grib la sogs pa zhi bar 'gyur ro// bdun pa ni/ glo bur ye 'drog yong dogs pa yod na/ rang yum chen mor bsgom/ de ma grub na yum chen mo yin bsam pa byas la ngag tu a mang po'am bdun yan chad ci 'grub bzlas na ye 'drog zhi'o// gzhan yang rta zhon pa'i dus dang*/ chu chen po brgal ba'i dus dang*/ 'jigs pa chen po 'ong gi dogs pa'i dus der a gdon pa gal che/ zla bo yod na yang kun la a rkyang gdon du gzhug pa gal che'o// lam 'phrang gnyen po phyags 'don gyi dus kyang de bzhin du a gdon par bya'o// las byed mkhan rnams de bzhin du a gdon du gzhug

rang gis lha bsgom par bya'o// dmag la 'gro yang dmag mi rnams kyis a bton na dgra las rgyal bar 'gyur ro// de skad du yang mtshan brjod las// a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /don chen yi ge dam pa yin// zhes gsungs so// jo bo spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan la mnal lam du bstan pa yin gsungs te/ lam 'phrang gnyan po phyags pa dang*/ mchod rten dang lha khang zhig ral gso ba dang*/ nyams pa can gyi phyir bcos byed na/ a thon la gyis gsungs/ gdam ngag 'di thugs rje chen po la byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis zhus/ de la bla ma rin po che khams pas gsan/ des maṅga la shrī/ des ratna nā tha/ des pradzñā gu ru'o// zhes dpal stag lung pa chen po bkra shis dpal gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs sna tshogs dngos grub kyi bum bzang las byung ba'o// ༈ /yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// a'i de kho na nyid bsgom pa la gsum ste/ lha'i sku la brten te bsgom pa dang*/ yig 'bru la brten te bsgom pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i don la brten te bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa sngon du btang nas/ thams cad stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo a dkar po tshon gang pa 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro bar bsam/ de nas 'phags pa mchod cing*/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don byas te/ de yongs su gyur pa las yum chen po gser gyi mdog can sku byad phun sum tshogs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yas gnyis pa na phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gnyis pa na pusti bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa/ me long dwangs pa'i gzugs brnyan ltar bsgom mo// de'i thugs kar zla ba dang yi ge gcig pa gsal bar bltas la/

de'i 'od kyis rang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi yum spyan drangs la bstim/ a'i sgra bar ma chad par bzlas pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa bsal bar bsam zhing ci nus kyi rnal 'byor du bya'o// lha bsgom pa'o// don gnyis pa'i man ngag ni/ rang yi dam gyi lha yin snyam du bsgoms la/ de'i thugs kar zla ba nya gang ba'i gdan la a dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba gzi brjid dang ldan pa gdugs la tog btsugs pa ltar bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud a'i rnam par gyur te rdul phra rab re re yang a'i gzugs su hrig gi yod par bsam mo// yig 'bru'i bzlas pa'o// don gsum pa'i man ngag ni/ yang dag pa'i 'od gsal ba yin pas/ de'i ngo bo rang sems dang tha mi dad snying gar a'i yig 'bru dkar la 'tsher bar bsam/ nam 'chi ba'i dus su/ sa chu la/ me rlung la/ rnam shes thim chad a la 'dus par bsam/ a'i don 'od gsal skye med yin pas ma bcos pa'i ngang la gzhag de nas rang gang 'dod pa'i gnas su rig pa gtad la a spyi bo nas yar rgyangs kyis 'phang ngo*// yang dag pa'i man ngag chos rje paṇa chen shākya shrī la/ chos rje lo tsā ba chen pos zhus/ de las bsod nams dbang phyug bdag gis zhus so// zhes khro phu lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyi man ngag brgya rtsa las byung ba'o// ༈ /sher phyin yi ge gcig ma'i gdams ngag zab don snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru pradzñā pā ra mi tā yai/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i yang snying yi ge gcig ma nyams su len par 'dod pas/ khrus byas stan bde ba la skyil mo krung bcas te byang chub sems kyi dran pa mngon du bzhag la/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddha3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid skad cig gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdangs can/

zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dang pos mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas bgrang phreng dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas pusti bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'i skur gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung po'i ri la/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig mang po dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so// de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to// kun dga' bo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma yi ge gcig ma zhes bya ba 'di sems can rnams la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir zungs shig 'di lta ste/ zhes gleng gzhi dang*/ mnyan par gdams pa'i don yid la dran bzhin du bton pa'i mthar/ rang nyid lha sku'i gsal snang stong par sbyangs te/ lce rtser a yig tsam la sems gzung*/ de yang mi dmigs par bsams la spros bral stong pa nyid kyi ngang du blo bzhag ste a nyi shu rtsa gcig gdon/ de nas rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang*/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang*/ dge slong de dag dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad kyis pha rol tu phyin pa rjes su rtogs shing yi rangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// zhes yi rang rdzogs par bton/ tshar grangs mang du gdon na'ang phyag 'tshal nas brtsams te bskyar/

mthar/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te// skye rga na 'chi rba klong 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /ces sogs bsngo smon bya'o// de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar nyams su blangs pas yum rgyas pa tshar re bton pa'i bsod nams dang mnyam pas mtshon phan yon dpag tu med pa dang*/ bdud dang bdud kyi ris kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad srung ba dang*/ myur du chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid mngon sum du rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no// zhes pa'ang yig rnying gsal byed dang bcas pa'i dgongs don snying por dril ba'i dge bas 'gro kun shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i go 'phang la myur du reg pa'i rgyur siddhi rastu// sarba maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
